import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
tube_od = 30       # 管外径 (mm)
tube_id = 24       # 管内径 (mm)
tube_length = 60   # 管长 (mm)
flange_od = 60     # 法兰外径 (mm)
flange_t = 8       # 法兰厚度 (mm)
bolt_pcd = 46      # 螺栓分布圆直径 (mm)
bolt_d = 5         # 螺栓孔直径 (mm)
bolt_count = 4     # 螺栓数量

# === 建模 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(flange_od / 2)
    .extrude(flange_t)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(tube_od / 2)
    .extrude(tube_length)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(tube_id, flange_t + tube_length)
)

# 螺栓孔
result = (
    result
    .faces("<Z").workplane()
    .polygon(bolt_count, bolt_pcd, forConstruction=True)
    .vertices()
    .hole(bolt_d)
)

show_object(result)
